name: Long March 12
location_str: Commercial LC-2 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: Ion thrusters can produce only about as much thrust as the weight of a sheet of paper, but can run continuously for months or years.
slot_b_text: The 48th launch of the year for China's CASC, 618th all time. Their year has run at a launch every six days. Worldwide, it is attempt number 238 of the year.
rocket_fact: Ion thrusters can produce only about as much thrust as the weight of a sheet of paper, but can run continuously for months or years.
